title: Study Abroad Insurance
scenario: An agency says your study abroad place will be cancelled without immediate insurance payment.

answers.A: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.B: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.
answers.C: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.D: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.

explanation: Study Abroad Insurance: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Program requirements should be checked with the university abroad office.
